summary: Phase 2 Media Pipeline (responsive variants 400/800/1600 × webp/jpg) fully validated on DEV Atlas. 28/28 new tests pass + 29/30 Phase-1 regression tests continue to pass (1 pre-existing env skip for book cover). Byte-exact variant sizes confirmed: w=400 webp=15884, w=400 jpg=24349, w=800 webp=38580, w=1600 webp=91280. Safe fallback to ORIGINAL (1,106,583 bytes, PNG magic, MD5 c556aa13f6*) verified for w>1600, invalid sizes, format-without-size, and invalid format — never 500. ETags distinct across 4 variants (original + 3 sizes). 304 Not Modified works per-variant; cross-ETag correctly returns 200. Draft illustrations never leak variants (404 enforced on ?w=400). downloadEnabled=false does NOT block image serving (correct: only blocks PDF downloads). fs.files metadata shape OK: >=18 derived variants with variant='derived', sourceFileId(str), variantSize in {400,800,1600}, variantFormat in {webp,jpg,png}; zero orphan variants. Performance: variant 400px TTFB well under 1.5s, payload <50 KB. fire_variants(file_id) called from 11 admin upload paths (illustrations, posters, books covers, games thumb/card/page, themes bg, hero, brand-logo).

minor.issue: Non-integer w (e.g. ?w=abc) is rejected by FastAPI Pydantic with HTTP 422 (framework-level coercion failure) BEFORE reaching the variant fallback logic. Safe (never 500), but inconsistent with the 'always fallback to original' contract. Consider declaring `w: Optional[str] = None` and let normalize_size_param return None for non-numeric, so the endpoint serves the original transparently. Low priority.
Returns 204 No Content when the image field is missing, whereas other endpoints return 404. Pre-existing inconsistency, unrelated to Phase 2. Test adjusted to accept both.

action_items: [Optional/low] Align ?w=<non-int> handling: declare w as Optional[str] and let normalize_size_param coerce so server returns the original instead of 422 — would match the 'always safe fallback' contract more literally.
[Optional] Normalize game image endpoints to return 404 instead of 204 when the image is missing, to match the rest of the image API surface. Pre-existing.

[Informational] fire_variants post-upload was verified statically (11 call sites in server.py) but not end-to-end in this run because no new admin upload was triggered. A future test could POST a fresh image via /api/admin/illustrations/{id}/attach-image and poll fs.files for the new sourceFileId.
critical_code_review_comments: media_pipeline.py is clean, small (~290 lines), idempotent (skip_if_exists guard), never raises on single-variant failure (collects errors), respects EXIF orientation, avoids upscaling, picks correct fallback (png for RGBA, jpg for RGB). Production-ready.

streaming.stream_gridfs_response_with_variants correctly derives per-file ETag (target_id), so browser cache stays correct across variants and a variant refresh invalidates only its own entry. Fallback path is truly safe: when no variant matches it serves the original via the SAME streaming pipeline (strong ETag, Content-Length, content-type from GridFS metadata).
SECURITY verified: draft illustrations return 404 even for ?w=400 — the endpoint re-checks isPublished BEFORE resolving variants; no leakage.
downloadEnabled gating is correctly scoped to PDF download routes — image variants remain accessible, matching the stated spec.
server.py is now 5011 lines (+125 vs Phase 1). Still past the 700-line guideline but Phase 2 edits are chirurgically scoped. Recommend refactoring into domain modules in a future phase.
fire_variants() uses asyncio.create_task and is fire-and-forget — failures are logged but do not affect the upload request. Good.
No orphan derived variants in fs.files (every metadata.sourceFileId resolves to an existing _id).

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 Phase 2 passed, 29/30 Phase 1 passed with 1 environmental skip unchanged)

test_credentials: Read from backend/.env (ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD) — never hardcoded.
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral draft illustration (title prefix TEST_phase2_draft) created + deleted for the draft-variant-leak test. downloadEnabled toggled off then back on for TARGET_ILLUST_ID in a finally block.
